remarks: Welcome home to this charming three bedroom, 2-bath Cape Cod situated on a spacious 1.29-acre lot in the Village of Mayville! Offering the convenience of first-floor living, this well-maintained home features a desirable primary bedroom and full bath and large walk in closet on the main level, while two additional bedrooms and a second full bath are located upstairs to provide plenty of space for family or guests. Beautiful hardwood floors flow throughout the main living areas, adding warmth and timeless character to the home's inviting interior. Forced air furnace and central air conditioning. An attached garage offers everyday convenience, while an additional outbuilding provides excellent space for storage, hobbies, or a workshop. Recent updates throughout, new since 2024: furnace and AC system 2024, Hot water heater, Chimney tear-off and replacement 2026, Windows throughout, paved Driveway, entry Doors, sub Basement drainage system and sump pump with transferable lifetime warranty, whole house water filtration system and water softener system , Reverse Osmosis drinking water filter system, Dryer , Dishwasher, Blinds fresh paint, etc..... Enjoy the outdoors with an expansive backyard and deck, perfect for entertaining, gardening, or simply relaxing in your own private outdoor retreat. With over an acre of land, there's plenty of room to spread out while still enjoying the benefits of village living. Located just minutes from the heart of the charming Village of Mayville, you'll love being close to local shops, restaurants, parks, and community events. Spend your days exploring nearby Chautauqua Lake, where boating, fishing, beaches, and year-round recreation await. Whether you're looking for a full-time residence or a peaceful getaway, this property offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and location.
